limitations.text: No glyph image is proposed: Commons pages for modern 友 oracle-style and Shuowen seal-style vector redraws were located, but their file-specific reuse terms were not verified. The Xiaoxuetang query page did not return an accessible character-specific image record in the web tool. The chardb.iis.sinica.edu.tw graph-evolution page is linked evidence only and states All Rights Reserved.
